description:
**THIS REQUIREMENT IS BEING SOLICITED TO SEAPORT NxG MAC HOLDERS ONLY.**

1. This Task Order will provide engineering services to NSWCPD Code 335 to support all aspects of Solid Waste Equipment, afloat hazardous material (HAZMAT) Control and Management, and P2A Equipment.

2. GFI: Due to file size constraints, all seventeen (17) drawings listed in Section 9.0 - Government Furnished Information (GFI) will  solely be available upon written request. Requests for these drawings shall be made within five (5) days of solicitation issuance and will be released using DoD SAFE. Requests shall be made via email to both contacts listed below:

Ayelet Sartin, Contract Specialist: Ayelet.J.Sartin.civ@us.navy.mil
Angela Cusati, Contracting Officer: Angela.F.Cusati.civ@us.navy.mil

3.  Submission of Questions:  In accordance with L-215-H007, the deadline for receipt of questions is 10 days after issuance of the solicitation. Although every effort will be made, the Government makes no guarantee that questions received after the date above will be answered.  All questions shall be submitted via email to the points of contact listed below:  

Ayelet Sartin, Contract Specialist: Ayelet.J.Sartin.civ@us.navy.mil
Angela Cusati, Contracting Officer: Angela.F.Cusati.civ@us.navy.mil
